title: The Oversight Gap: What LLM Safety Monitors Miss, and Why It Is Not Capability
abstract: arXiv:2609.07162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Several properties safety monitors are asked to certify, among them cross-tenant noninterference, sandbagging and evaluation awareness, are 2-safety hyperproperties, witnessed only by two executions. The standard consequence is a binary impossibility: one trace cannot decide them. We replace the binary with a measurement. A tight bound puts the balanced accuracy of any single-trace monitor at $\tfrac12+\tfrac12\,TV(P_0,P_1)$, turning undecidability into a graded detectability frontier and defining an oversight gap: a monitor's shortfall below it. On a leak family with closed-form $TV$, nine LLM monitors are optimal at $TV=0$ but capture little signal as $TV$ grows; at $TV=1$, where a 20-line membership check scores $100\%$, they average $60.9\%$. translated_title: 监督缺口：LLM安全监控器遗漏了什么，以及为什么这不是能力问题
translated_abstract: 安全监控器被要求认证的若干性质，包括跨租户非干扰、沙袋行为和评估意识，属于2-安全性超性质，只能通过两次执行才能见证。标准结论是一个二元的不可判定性：单条轨迹无法判定它们。我们用度量取代了这种二元判定。一个紧致界将任何单轨迹监控器的平衡准确率限定在 $\tfrac12+\tfrac12\,TV(P_0,P_1)$，从而将不可判定性转化为分级的可检测性前沿，并由此定义了“监督缺口”：即监控器低于该前沿的差距。在一个具有闭式全变差的泄漏族上，九个LLM监控器在 $TV=0$ 时表现最优，但随着 $TV$ 增大只能捕获很少的信号；在 $TV=1$ 时，一段20行的成员检查代码能达到100%的准确率，而这些监控器平均只得60.9%。这一差距主要并非能力问题：明确指出需要检查什么能够弥合其中61%的差距，同时使 $TV=0$ 的对照保持在随机水平。同样的二分法贯穿于一个 $2\times2$ 因子实验：一个想象的...（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了“监督缺口”的概念，给出单轨迹监控器检测2-安全性超性质的紧致理论界限，并通过实验证明LLM安全监控器的失效主要源于缺乏明确的检测规范而非能力不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "oversight gap" concept with a tight theoretical bound on single-trace monitor detectability of 2-safety hyperproperties, showing empirically that LLM safety monitors' failures stem primarily from missing explicit specifications of what to check rather than limited capability.
